I have investigated the failing test case [`TestUnboundedFifoBuffer.testCollections220`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/collections_8_group_d_arch/src/test/org/apache/commons/collections/buffer/TestUnboundedFifoBuffer.java#L416-L424) and traced the issue.

### Findings
* **Failing Test**: In `org.apache.commons.collections.buffer.TestUnboundedFifoBuffer::testCollections220`, an empty [`UnboundedFifoBuffer`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/collections_8_group_d_arch/src/java/org/apache/commons/collections/buffer/UnboundedFifoBuffer.java#L66) is serialized and deserialized. An element (`"Foo"`) is then added to the buffer, but `buffer.size()` evaluates to `0` instead of `1`.
* **Intended Behavior**: After an empty buffer is serialized and deserialized, it should remain fully functional such that adding elements increases its size accordingly.

The living requirement has been created in [`requirement.feature`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/collections_8_group_d_arch/requirement.feature).
